nodes.summary: For a purchase price $B$, the break-even strategy is the deterministic strategy that buys on day $B$.
nodes.title: Break-even strategy

nodes.summary: For every purchase price $B \ge 1$ and every season length $d \in \mathbb{N}$, the cost $\mathrm{cost}_B(\mathrm{breakEven}_B, d)$ of the break-even strategy for a season of $d$ days is at most $2 \cdot \mathrm{opt}_B(d)$, twice the offline optimum $\mathrm{opt}_B(d)$. In particular, the break-even strategy is $2$-competitive.
nodes.title: The break-even strategy pays at most twice the optimum

nodes.summary: For every purchase price $B \ge 1$ and every season length $d$, the break-even strategy $\mathrm{breakEven}_B$ pays at most $2 - 1/B$ times the offline optimum $\mathrm{opt}_B(d)$: its cost $\mathrm{cost}_B(\mathrm{breakEven}_B, d)$ for a season of $d$ days satisfies $B \cdot \mathrm{cost}_B(\mathrm{breakEven}_B, d) \le (2B - 1) \cdot \mathrm{opt}_B(d)$.
nodes.title: Ski-rental upper bound for the break-even strategy

nodes.summary: Renting skis costs $1$ per day and buying them costs a natural number $B$. The cost $\mathrm{cost}_B(s, d) \in \mathbb{N}$ of a strategy $s$ for a season of $d \in \mathbb{N}$ days is $(t - 1) + B$ if $s$ buys on a day $t$ with $1 \le t \le d$ (rent for $t - 1$ days, then buy), and $d$ otherwise, that is, if $s$ rents forever or buys on a day $t$ with $t = 0$ or $t > d$ (rent every day).
nodes.title: Cost of a ski-rental strategy

nodes.summary: Every deterministic strategy pays at least `(2 - 1/B)` times the optimum on some season, `(2 B - 1) * opt ≤ B * cost`.
nodes.title: Lower bound

nodes.summary: For every purchase price $B$, every deterministic strategy $s$ and every season length $d$, the offline optimum $\mathrm{opt}_B(d)$ is at most the cost $\mathrm{cost}_B(s, d)$ of $s$ for a season of $d$ days.
nodes.title: The offline optimum bounds every strategy's cost

nodes.summary: For a purchase price $B \in \mathbb{N}$ and a season of $d \in \mathbb{N}$ days, the offline optimum is $\mathrm{opt}_B(d) = \min(d, B)$: rent every day or buy on day one, whichever is cheaper.
nodes.title: Offline optimum for ski rental

nodes.summary: A deterministic strategy is either a day $t \in \mathbb{N}$ on which to buy the skis, after renting on the days before it, or the choice to rent forever. Days are numbered from $1$; the value $t = 0$ is also a strategy, and the cost treats it as renting forever.
nodes.title: Deterministic ski-rental strategy
